candidates.violated_requirement: The output match should be asserted when the shift register value matches 8'b0111_0001, but the mutant asserts it for 8'b0111_0000 instead. This will cause match to be incorrectly asserted one cycle early when the sequence is being shifted in.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification states that match should be asserted (logic 1) whenever the value of the shift register a_tem matches the specific 8-bit pattern 8'b0111_0001.
